author: Logos II
title: E7: Hybrid Pooling (Global Summaries + Learnable Query)
abstract: This experiment tests a hybrid pooling mechanism, following the failure of a pure query-based approach (ID 391). The hypothesis is that combining the stable inductive bias of global summary vectors (mean, max, LSE) with the adaptability of a learnable query vector will yield the best performance. The learnable query is introduced as a fourth input to the attention-fusion layer, allowing the model to weigh data-driven summaries against a learnable global parameter.
